status: Verified native-grid representation exclusion and scene-point admission frontier, not implementation.
representation: Serialize/Deserialize enum retains source-grid x/z u16 plus rock recipe. It is not an existing checked scene-plan point being erased.
producer_evidence: generation.rs:80-121 derives row/column ordinals from the source environment raster and uses them as deterministic RNG context
generation.rs:124-140 uses the original grid cells for corridor/camera reservation predicates
generation/geographic.rs:9-63 retains the native-grid product through source-grid/detail preparation
generation/supported.rs:7-49 retains it after actual owned support installation and clears accepted bearings/approaches
detail_obstacles.rs:4-49 already admits native grid conversion into canonical ScenePlanPoint for terrain/detail kernels
migration_boundary: Keep grid ordinals at their actual raster/serialized ports. At each scene-geometry consumer, admit the complete native grid-to-metres result once and retain ScenePlanPoint through application helpers/support queries. Reuse TerrainDetailObstacles existing typed fields; do not rewrap them. Do not create an equivalent bespoke grid/point type just to replace a serialized primitive spelling.
arithmetic_risk: The generator uses (index - source_half) * spacing for its native collar context, while server/capture/detail consumers use index * spacing - terrain_half. These are not guaranteed bit-identical f32 expressions. Do not unify them mechanically or move admission ahead of each complete calculation. Preserve each existing operation order and context/iteration bits.
required_support: A serialized grid coordinate does not prove a physical hit exists after support reconstruction. Server/capture required placement must reject missing support; optional visual candidates may omit it. No zero-height substitute.

P04_boundary_spotcheck.finding: No newly suspected u64-to-usize budget truncation exists. CoalescedEventBudget compares full-width AnimationEventSpan directly, and contacts iterate/reverse typed u64 offsets without an index cast. No source change required.
P04_boundary_spotcheck.scope: Focused verification of the existing migration before acceptance, not another full bespoke-audit wave.
